# Database compatibility fixture

`4aba0a6-v8.sql` is a SQLite dump of synthetic data generated by the engine at
commit `4aba0a67deb80b2de631b0e76ab55b274f184fcd`, which uses schema v8.
The source commit was extracted into an isolated temporary directory. A test
using that commit's engine created three accounts (including a Unicode name),
a room, room and private messages, a session, a read cursor, and an inert
`x:group.su.assign` grant. The engine checkpointed the database before export.
All names, passwords, session identifiers, and messages are test fixtures.

The current engine regression imports the dump into a temporary database and
checks the existing v8-to-v9 upgrade, preserved identities and data, current
writes, legacy grant revocation, and reopening. It never touches working data.
Session preservation is checked independently of wall-clock expiry so the
fixture remains useful after its original test session expires.

This covers opening baseline data with the updated server. Schema v9 cannot
be opened by the old v8 binary; downgrade still requires the pre-upgrade backup.
